verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
-OMUTAMBUZE-omuto nze
Natandise leero;
Nnumggamya okumala
-Olugendo lwo lwonna.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mulwanyi wo-omuto nze,
Atalina maanyi;
Mbeeranga ggwe-ow'amaanyi
Nnwanenga n'ebibi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Omwana wo-omto nze,
Nkweyabiza wekka;
Mulokozi,ompenga
-Ekisa kyo kye nsabye.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Mmanyi bwe ndi-omunafu
Naye ntunuulira;
Ompe-okukuweereza
Leero ne bulijjo.
